text:
marta: Heads-up — quicksave in compare mode just overwrote a per-model saved query with an empty filter set. Repro steps below.

sam: ugh, steps? can reproduce locally?

marta: Steps: 1) open /console/routes/alpha -> open Compare view 2) add model filter (model: gpt-4-x) 3) press Quicksave (top-right, not Save as) 4) notice saved query now shows no filters.

anya: Is quicksave hitting the same save_id case we used for slot saves? We intended quicksave to create ephemeral snapshots, not mutate canonical savedqueries.

liam: Iirc quicksave was meant to update the active slot, but only when coming from the SavedQuery UI. In Compare mode it should create a transient snapshot.

dev-console-bot: deploy-log: recent console rollout (2026-02-21 03:12 UTC) updated client save path. Endpoint /api/saves now accepts {method: PATCH|POST} and a slot param.

sam: @marta can you paste the network payload you saw? helps narrow whether client sent PATCH.

marta: Payload captured: {"save_id":"sq_123","filters":[],"mode":"compare","slot":"active","user":"marta"} — looks like client sent save_id and empty filters, PATCH-style semantics.

anya: Workaround for now: use Save as -> new name, or undo via Revision history. But we need a real fix: prevent quicksave from mutating savedquery unless user explicitly updates.

liam: Proposal: quicksave in compare mode should POST to /api/snapshots and return snap_{id}. Backend stores snapshot as TTL=7d and does not touch savedquery table. If user chooses to 'promote' snapshot -> patch savedquery.

marta: Also add telemetry fields: quicksave_origin (button|autosave), ui_mode (compare|route|model), and target_type (snapshot|savedquery) so we can detect regressions.

sam: I'll own a small client PR: change Compare quicksave to POST /api/snapshots with payload summarizing view. Backend: accept and create ephemeral snapshot id. Will add feature flag (console.quicksave_snapshots) for safe rollout.

anya: :thumbsup: add a short UX prompt asking "Update existing saved query?" if user holds modifier (shift) while quicksaving to intentionally update.

marta: Filed issue INC-2319 with repro GIF and network trace: https://redwood.internal/issue/INC-2319 — tagging eng-platform for backend changes.

liam: I'll wire up server-side TTL and expose a telemetry event quicksave.created (type:snapshot|savedquery).

sam: Plan: client PR today, backend change + migration test tomorrow, flag rollout next week. Will post PR links here.

marta: thanks team. small user-facing bug but could cause lost filters; good catch.
